name: tab01
definition: 主数据实体一 Counterexample: 与 tab02 的区分：tab02 含 fld004 且引用 fld002，属从属记录而非本主数据 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab01; provenance: direct source tab01

name: tab02
definition: 从属记录二 Counterexample: 与 tab01 的区分：本表通过 fld002 依附于 tab01，自身不被他表以 fld002 之外键广泛引用 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab02; provenance: direct source tab02

name: tab03
definition: 独立实体三 Counterexample: 与 tab01 的区分：本表无 fld001/fld002 等共享主键列，属独立维度而非主数据族成员 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: tab04
definition: 业务明细记录 Counterexample: 与 tab05 的区分：本表为多外键汇聚的明细记录，tab05 仅含 fld001、fld010、fld015 三列，属更窄的关联记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab04; provenance: direct source tab04

name: tab05
definition: 关联记录五 Counterexample: 与 tab04 的区分：本表列数少且不含 fld004、fld007 等外键，是 tab01 与 tab04 之间的窄关联记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab05; provenance: direct source tab05

name: CustomerSegment
definition: The business segment a customer belongs to (SME, LAM, KAM).

name: MonthlyConsumption
definition: The consumption amount recorded for a customer in a given month.

name: YearMonth
definition: The year-month key (YYYYMM) of a consumption record.

name: PaymentCurrency
definition: The currency in which a customer pays.

name: Customer
definition: A unique customer entity.

name: GasStationChain
definition: The chain number a gas station belongs to.

name: Country
definition: The country where a gas station is located.

name: TransactionTime
definition: The timestamp at which a transaction occurred.

name: ProductDescription
definition: The description of a product consumed in a transaction.

name: Transaction
definition: A single fuel/product purchase event at a gas station.

name: AnnualConsumption
definition: Total consumption of a customer/segment within a calendar year. Formula: SUM(MonthlyConsumption) filtered to YearMonth year. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = tab05.fld015; YearMonth = tab05.fld010

name: EuroCustomerCount
definition: Number of distinct customers whose payment currency is EUR. Formula: COUNT DISTINCT(Customer) WHERE PaymentCurrency = 'EUR'. Inputs: Customer = tab01.fld001; PaymentCurrency = tab01.fld003

name: HighValueEuroCustomers
definition: Euro-paying customers whose monthly consumption exceeds 1000. Formula: COUNT DISTINCT(Customer) WHERE PaymentCurrency='EUR' AND MonthlyConsumption > 1000. Inputs: Customer = tab01.fld001; PaymentCurrency = tab01.fld003; MonthlyConsumption = tab05.fld015
aliases: euro customers with monthly consumption over 1000

name: PeakConsumptionMonth
definition: The month with the maximum total consumption in a period. Formula: ARGMAX(SUM(MonthlyConsumption)) BY YearMonth. Inputs: MonthlyConsumption = tab05.fld015; YearMonth = tab05.fld010

name: TransactionsAfterDate
definition: Number of transactions occurring after a given date. Formula: COUNT(Transaction) WHERE TransactionTime > '2012-01-01'. Inputs: Transaction = tab04.fld009; TransactionTime = tab04.fld013

name: CustomerSegmentation
definition: Which customer segment (SME, LAM, KAM) drives consumption and how segments compare.

name: PaymentCurrency
definition: How consumption splits by payment currency.
